name: Armaros Woodridge
source:
One of the leaders of a pro-monster/anti-human cult headquartered at the Aibek, alongside his twin sister Aurora. He is timid and usually lets her do the talking.

[spoiler]Unbeknownst to his sister, he is courting the demon princess Elaine Morningstar. At the end of the game, he proposes to her and they become engaged to be married, and leaves the Aibek.[/spoiler]
